hero.title: Meet EmmiTec: Transforming Lives with Healthcare
hero.subtitle: Meet the story and the people behind the platform transforming remote patient monitoring in Brazil and worldwide.

story.title: The EmmiTec Journey
story.intro: Emilio Machado founded EmmiTec inspired by his mother's journey against cancer in 2017. Facing challenges such as constant medical visits and scattered records, he created a digital registry to centralize information and improve care, even from a distance. This innovation gave rise to the Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) platform, which collects real-time data, aids early intervention, and improves clinical outcomes and quality of patient care, transforming healthcare globally.
story.paragraph1: EmmiTec's journey began in 2006, developing cutting-edge technology for sectors like finance and retail, in partnership with major innovators like Apple. However, in 2017, our story shifted to something more personal and profound. That year, Emilio Machado, our founder, faced his mother's difficult battle against cancer.
story.paragraph2: Beyond the emotional impact, managing her care was an immense challenge: constant medical visits, medication schedules, and scattered health records. The geographical distance made everything even harder—while his mother was in Brazil, Emilio lived in the United States. Determined to make a difference, he developed a remote monitoring platform that allowed tracking health data from afar. This solution not only improved his mother's quality of life but gave Emilio the chance to support her even from a distance. In 2018, EmmiTec decided to focus exclusively on healthcare, selling its other divisions to transform medical care and help more families face similar challenges.
story.quote: The most powerful technology is that which cares for the people we love.

mission.title: Our Mission and Vision at EmmiTec
mission.description: At EmmiTec, we believe that health goes beyond a service—it is an essential right, belonging to everyone, regardless of where they are. We dream of a world where distance, circumstances, or resources do not define the quality of care received. This vision drives us to develop innovative solutions that empower people to take control of their health. EmmiTec Health is more than a platform; it is a commitment to delivering integrated, patient-centered care that is accessible and deeply human. Our mission is to break down barriers in healthcare, ensuring that every patient is valued, supported, and cared for according to their needs. Because when it comes to health, there are no 'others' or 'another time'. Change starts now, and we are ready to lead it.

hero.title: Real-time Remote Patient Monitoring
hero.subtitle: RPM is the technology that collects clinical data from patients outside the hospital and sends it, in real time, to the healthcare team — enabling faster interventions and continuous care.

definition.title: Health monitored beyond the clinic walls
definition.paragraph1: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) uses connected medical devices to track vital signs and clinical indicators directly from the patient's home. Data is transmitted in real time to the platform, where AI algorithms identify trends and alert the team about relevant events.
definition.paragraph2: With RPM, chronic conditions, post-op care, and preventive health gain continuous follow-up — without the patient having to leave home. More autonomy, fewer unnecessary visits, and clinical decisions based on real data.

process.title: Four steps to truly connected care
process.subtitle: From the device on the patient to clinical decision-making, every step is designed to deliver reliable data and timely actions.

step1.title: Collect
step1.desc: Certified medical devices capture vital signs like blood pressure, oximetry, glucose, and ECG.

step2.title: Transmit
step2.desc: Data is sent via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi to the platform with end-to-end encryption.

step3.title: AI analysis
step3.desc: Algorithms identify abnormal patterns, trends, and flag potential clinical risks.

step4.title: Alert and act
step4.desc: Clinical teams receive prioritized notifications and act before situations escalate.

who.title: Who benefits most from remote monitoring
who.subtitle: RPM does not replace the appointment — it covers the gap between appointments. Four profiles account for most of the cases where that gap matters.
who.item1desc: Hypertension, heart failure, and arrhythmias need frequent pressure and rhythm readings — data a quarterly appointment never captures.
who.item2desc: In the weeks after discharge, most complications show up at home, far from the team that performed the surgery.
who.item3desc: Glycemic control depends on continuous adjustment. With readings arriving on their own, treatment changes in days, not months.
who.item4desc: Multiple comorbidities and medications, combined with limited mobility, make remote follow-up the safest route.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Emmitec Health builds Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) solutions, apps, and a clinical platform. This document explains how we handle personal and health-related data when you use the website and our services.

sections.title: 2. Data we may collect
sections.body: We may collect identification and contact details (name, email, phone), professional information, data submitted via forms or bookings, and technical browsing data (IP, device, pages visited) for security and experience improvement.

sections.title: 3. How we use data
sections.body: We use data to respond to requests, schedule demos, send communications when authorized, operate and improve the site and services, meet legal obligations, and protect platform security.

sections.title: 4. Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell personal data. We may share information with essential providers (hosting, email, analytics) under contract, or when required by law. Clinical health data follows specific controls and agreements with partner institutions.

sections.title: 5. Security and retention
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational measures aligned with market best practices and applicable requirements (including privacy laws). We keep data only as long as needed for stated purposes or legal requirements.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, anonymization, portability, or deletion of personal data, and revoke consents, within applicable law. We will respond through official contact channels.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and website
sections.body: The site may use cookies and similar technologies for operation, language preferences, and usage metrics. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: 8. Changes
sections.body: We may update these Privacy Terms periodically. The revision date will appear on this page. Continued use of the site after changes means you acknowledge the current version.
